correctness.rationale: Expanding the 3x3 determinant gives (lambda+d)^3+(S+t²)(lambda+d)+Gt, with U=d(t²+d²+S)+Gt and H=2dt²-Gt+2d(4d²+S). The cubic Routh-Hurwitz iff U,H>0 establishes all parameter cases and their boundaries. The signs of Routh first columns give two complex right-half-plane roots in the positive-G window and one positive real root in the negative-G window. Exact example polynomials and roots were rederived independently and symbolically checked from the packaged verifier. A diagonally weighted skew decomposition proves strict forest stability. At non-Hurwitz tangencies no nonlinear stability is claimed.

originality.rationale: The exact equal-damping, one-reciprocal-link Hurwitz phase diagram is not stated in the inspected full texts of Solimano–Beretta (1982) or Allesina–Tang (2011), nor in the examined scientific abstracts and public research-index claims. The 1982 cyclic-loop criteria are sufficient, whereas the new statement is an exact necessity-and-sufficiency classification with two different spectral mechanisms. The 1979 and 1987 loop papers are plausible broader antecedents, but their full mathematical content was inaccessible, leaving non-negligible originality risk; these are expressly not asserted non-covering.
residual_risks: Roy–Solimano 1987 examines three-species Volterra loops and oscillations; inaccessible full text could establish a stronger parameter criterion implying this local phase diagram.
Krikorian 1979 classifies thirty-four three-species Volterra cases; inaccessible full text could imply specializations of this result.
The exact threshold formulas use classical cubic Hurwitz algebra. Independent readers may view the proposed phase diagram as an unsurprising corollary rather than a literature-original theorem.
Scientific literature searches do not prove global novelty.

value.rationale: Complete exact parameter classification of a natural minimal reciprocal antagonistic three-species loop identifies when strengthening a single ecological interaction can cause stability loss and recovery, and distinguishes oscillatory versus real-eigenvalue mechanisms. The graph-theoretic forest obstruction and realizable integer witnesses show the three-cycle is the smallest motif; these combine topology with the signed cyclic flux imbalance G=be-ac. Unlike an arbitrary coefficient example, the classification is for all positive interaction magnitudes and damping within a concrete controlled model. It is local and does not imply nonlinear species persistence.
